notes.title: New DLC released; Nintendo Switch version of PumPum available!
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! A new DLC for the game has just been released, don't miss it! This time it adds 3 more girls to the game. 

Why did it take so long to release it? Because I also worked hard on the Nintendo Switch™ version of PumPum. Together with PlayZilla.studio we ported the game, and it was much more difficult than expected. Both the art, GUI, and code needed numerous changes and optimizations, but now I'm proud to announce that the game is available for pre-order on the Nintendo eShop for 25% off (!). Just in case some of you didn't know, unlike Early Access on Steam, pre-ordering on Nintendo eShop means that the game is 100% ready and has passed their (very strict, by the way) review process. It's set for release on August 8.

-What's new?
-PumPum NS features Local Multiplayer and Endless game modes as well as countless amount of improvements.

-What makes it unique? 
-You won't find other games with sexy naked animated girls and boobs on NSwitch! The game is unique. It took a long time to discuss the content with Nintendo and thankfully they allowed the game to be released.

-Is there any censorship in the game?
-Nope!

-Why does it cost so much? $20?!
-Because it has more girls! Almost ALL of the girls from the PumPum DLC are included in the default NSwitch version. And, of course, don't miss out on the pre-order discount!

-No naked breasts for Japanese, Korean and Hong Kong players?
-Unfortunately, that kind of stuff is not allowed by local regulators and Nintendo.

-What about Germany and Australia?
-Don't blame me, blame your governments.

I guess not all of you are Nintendo Switch fans, but porting the game took me so much time and effort that I think it deserves a mention.

I'll also be releasing a couple more DLC for other games!

Whoo000pee!

notes.title: New Games Announcement!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40342831/7a0bb554dd4a2acd4954248f4beda02486466198.jpg
Greetings everyone, how you doing?! I have great news for you!

I'm so happy and excited to let you know that I'm going to release two new games in 2023: PumPum 2 and Poozle!

Both of them will be released in Q1 of 2023. The games are half-finished, and there's still plenty of work to do, but I'm very satisfied with how they look for now.

Please keep in mind that the games are still in development and some of the content (like screenshots, trailer or description) is subject to change.

I'm also looking for people who can translate text from these games into new languages. If you are willing to help, please PM me. For those who are wondering why I don't want to hire a professional translator: you are the most motivated, creative and possibly obscene translators I can find! There is not so much text for translation, about half an A4 page.

Stay tuned!

Cheers and Merry Christmas!
